component.name: TuxStack
component.summary: Native Docker management for KDE Plasma

description.p: TuxStack is a native Docker management application for Linux desktops, designed for KDE Plasma and built with Rust, Qt, Kirigami, and Bollard.

It manages local Docker Engine containers, images, networks and volumes from a lightweight, fast, native interface that follows the system theme. A matching command-line tool shares the same core library.
Current status: alpha. Compose projects, container terminal and file browsing are planned but not yet implemented. Incus is a future consideration and not currently supported.
Alpha release: Docker container lifecycle, logs, stats; image, network and volume listing; Kirigami GUI and shared CLI.
